title: Meshy Sells Pro Plan for $1 to Launch First Hermes Agent Plugin
summary:
A new promotion enables those using the Hermes agent to obtain an upgraded account from Meshy at a low cost. The offer provides one month of the Pro tier for $1, which includes 1,000 credits and API access. To activate the membership, users must install the official plugin and paste a generated API key into the settings of the Hermes Desktop application.

The discount coincides with the launch of a plugin that allows Hermes to generate, rig, and animate 3D models from text or photos via Meshy's MCP server. The integration supports the creation of high-fidelity assets, such as 70m poly models for Godot, with models rendering directly in the desktop chat and preview videos sent to users on messaging apps.

selectedTweets.quotedTweetText:
Hermes Agent now has an official plugin for @MeshyAI. 

Ask Hermes to make a 70m poly treasure chest for Godot, or to turn a photo of a mug into a model you can print, and it does the job through Meshy's MCP server. 

In Hermes Desktop the models render in chat, rigged characters animate inline, and a gallery stores every model and prompt. On messaging apps, Hermes sends a short preview video so you can create on the go.
